title: Lu11 8-round AES-192 Impossible boomerang recovery

target.description: Source first8 rounds, initial whitening. Supporting impossible-boomerang interval excludesMC at its terminal round; full attack has the Section5.1 boundary, not an arbitrary stripped suffix. Step7 completes the remaining128 masterkeybits after eight initial bytes; the88-bit combined subkey guess is not88 independent recovered masterkeybits.

setting.key_relation: Two unknown keys KA=KC and KB=KD; nonzero source XOR master-key relation for E0, zero pair relation for E1. Table2 AES192 related-subkey propagation.
setting.plaintext_model: Chosen plaintext observations under two unknown keys with the stated XOR relation.

time.note: Source total native encryptions; hash-table memory-access subterms are not a memory-capacity estimate. Includes final128-bit exhaustive completion expected2^156.04. Direct summation of native phase expressions is approximately2^167.62; author headline2^167.7 is a conservative rounded estimate. The prose quartet sequence uses133.38/69.38/21.38 while later cost lines use133.48/117.48/69.48/21.48; this local notation mismatch is retained, not escalated into a false headline-cost conflict. Source survival28.04 is reproduced by its coarse log2(e) approximately1.44 approximation.

memory.note: No numerical amount is reported for this resource. Ciphertext-pair/quartet hash-table access counts are operation counts, not a reported peak capacity.

preprocessing.note: No numerical amount is reported for this resource.

success.description: The source reports expected wrong-key survivor counts and exhaustive completion work, not numerical finite-budget whole-key success. A per-fixed-wrong-guess survival model is not the probability that the correct key is recovered or uniquely remains.

review.scope: Exact-edition endpoint-specific success/probability re-audit. Supporting identities, source-model filters, sampled-table fractions and whole-output success remain separate; no new full-paper/forward audit or conflict resolution.

components.description: Sections5.1–5.2 and the defining impossible-boomerang property: under the valid intended key/structure conditions, a true key cannot produce the contradiction used to discard a guess. This local no-false-rejection event does not bound the cost of residual exhaustive search.
